## The question

[Label sides of rectangles and triangles](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/13539/label-sides-of-rectangles-and-triangles), asked by [student](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/4011/student) on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-03-15; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> What is the easiest way to label the sides of rectangles and triangles in TikZ?
:::

I usually use nodes placed along the path that draws the polygon.

```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}

\begin{tikzpicture}
% Rectangle with labeled edges
\draw (0,0)  -| (5,3) 
	node[pos=0.25,below] {$\ell$} 
	node[pos=0.75,right] {$w$}
	-| (0,0);
\end{tikzpicture}

\begin{tikzpicture}
\draw[rotate=30] (0,0)  -| (5,3) 
	node[pos=0.25,below] {$\ell$} 
	node[pos=0.75,right] {$w$}
	-| (0,0);	
\end{tikzpicture}

\begin{tikzpicture}
\draw (0,0) -- (4,0) node[midway,below] {$a$}
   -- (2,4) node[midway,right] {$b$}
   -- (0,0) node[midway,left] {$c$};
\end{tikzpicture}

\end{document}
```
